title: Image built on an Apple Silicon Mac crashes with 'exec format error' on an amd64 server
symptoms: The requested image's platform (linux/arm64/v8) does not match the detected host platform (linux/amd64) and no specific platform was requested
no matching manifest for linux/arm64/v8 in the manifest list entries
cause: docker build targets the build machine's architecture unless told otherwise, so an M-series Mac produces linux/arm64 images. The reverse happens when an image publishes only amd64 and you pull it on the Mac without a platform.
fix: Set the target platform explicitly when building images for servers, and set platform in Compose for images that only ship amd64 so Desktop runs them under emulation.
apply:
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t "$IMAGE" --push .
# compose
services:
  app:
    platform: linux/amd64
affected: Docker Desktop on Apple Silicon (M1 and later); Rosetta emulation on by default since Desktop 4.25 on macOS 14.1 and later
